name: Eletrobras Participacoes S.A. - Eletropar
summary: Eletrobras Participações S.A. - Eletropar participates in electric power and other companies in Brazil. The company was formerly known as Light Participações S.A – LIGHTPAR and changed its name to Eletrobras Participações S.A. - Eletropar in September 2008. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Eletrobras Participações S.A. - Eletropar is a subsidiary of Centrais Elétricas Brasileiras S.A. – Eletrobras.
